description: Source code implementing time zone parsing functions for POSIX time zone specifications within the Abseil C++ library, including parsing of abbreviations, offsets, and date/time formats.

methods.name: ParseInt
methods.description: Parses an integer from a string within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: ParseAbbr
methods.description: Parses a timezone abbreviation, either in <...> format or as a string of at least 3 characters.

methods.name: ParseOffset
methods.description: Parses a time offset in hours, minutes, and seconds, with sign handling.

methods.name: ParseDateTime
methods.description: Parses date/time specifications in various formats (e.g., Jn, n, Mm.w.d) and optional offset.

methods.name: ParsePosixSpec
methods.description: Parses a full POSIX timezone specification string into a PosixTimeZone structure.
